known_defects: PHPStan reports 'Constant FLOSC_PLUGIN_DIR/FLOSC_PLUGIN_URL not found' (102 sites). Cause: flosc.php defines them as define('FLOSC_PLUGIN_DIR', plugin_dir_path(__FILE__)) — the value is a function call PHPStan cannot resolve cross-file. The regex-list bootstrap fix belongs in phpstan.neon.dist which is mirror-guarded (sha256-checked by flosc-test doctor); editing it would fail integrity. Counted and documented rather than hidden.

Remaining PHPStan dead-check warnings (alreadyNarrowedType, alwaysTrue, nullCoalesce.offset, etc.) are genuine always-true defensive is_*/empty checks left in place to avoid removing defensive code without per-site verification; each is provably dead but harmless.
